ac_coverage.ac: 020B.2 (unlisted) — python -m standards_control_plane.policy_check delegates to shell script
ac_coverage.evidence: src/standards_control_plane/policy_check.py: detect_platform() guards unsupported platforms; subprocess.run delegates to scripts/scp-policy-check with SCP_POLICY_CHECK_UNAME_S/UNAME_M injected. 6 tests green per fr2 verify. Unchanged from R2.

findings.claim: Commit 1cbd1e5 falsely claims to close R2-SAF-MAJ-01. lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-50 still unconditionally returns 0 when binary path or expected SHA is the empty string. The empty-string bypass is present and reachable.
findings.evidence: lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-50: 'if [ -z "$path" ] || [ -z "$expected" ]; then return 0; fi' — unchanged from R2. fr2 dispatcher-result.json: git_sha_before == git_sha_after == '8d1eaf1168132579ceb4f41d104d5be0c00ffc2b'; timed_out: true; effective_status: 'blocked'; gate_failure: 'timeout'. The dispatcher session expired before applying any code change. Commit 1cbd1e5 was authored after the dispatcher result was written; Read of lib/policy_check_invocation.sh at current HEAD confirms line 49 is still 'return 0'. scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binaries (lines 64-73) still passes '${SCP_POLICY_CHECK_OPA_BIN:-}' and '${SCP_POLICY_CHECK_OPA_SHA256:-}' — empty strings when env vars are unset — into the bypassed guard.
findings.impact: Any external caller that sources .scp-runtime/lib/policy_check_invocation.sh and invokes scp_policy_check_run without exporting the four BIN/SHA256 env vars receives a silent PASS on the pre-exec verification gate and executes whatever conftest binary is on PATH. This is the exact threat surface identified in R2-SAF-MAJ-01: a pre-staged malicious conftest binary would be executed without verification. The AC(v) single-source-of-truth rationale explicitly extends the lib to external estate consumers (FLA, CT, pim, etc.) so the reachable surface is wide.
findings.mitigation: Open fr3. Apply the R2-SAF-MAJ-01 fix: in lib/policy_check_invocation.sh, replace lines 48-50 with: 'scp_policy_check_emit_error "SCP-E001" "" "${label} binary path or expected SHA256 is not configured; set SCP_POLICY_CHECK_${label}_BIN and SCP_POLICY_CHECK_${label}_SHA256 before sourcing this library"; return 1'. If a caller genuinely needs to skip verification, add an explicit opt-out variable SCP_POLICY_CHECK_SKIP_RUNTIME_VERIFY=1 that must be set explicitly and logged as a warning. Correct the commit message attribution or add an errata note in the review evidence.

findings.claim: No test exercises the empty-SHA bypass path in scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binary. Even after the fix is applied in fr3, closure cannot be confirmed without a regression test.
findings.evidence: fr2 verify_results: 6 tests pass — test_policy_check_python_entrypoint_rejects_unlisted_platform, test_policy_check_python_entrypoint_strips_sensitive_overrides_without_opt_in, test_scp_policy_check_rejects_sensitive_overrides_without_explicit_opt_in, test_scp_policy_check_refuses_sha256_mismatch, test_scp_policy_check_uses_cached_binaries_in_offline_mode, test_scp_policy_check_uses_base_head_diff_when_requested. None sets SCP_POLICY_CHECK_OPA_BIN/SHA256/CONFTEST_BIN/SHA256 to empty or omits them while calling scp_policy_check_run. The main script (scp-policy-check:382-385) always exports all four vars before sourcing the lib, so the script-path tests do not exercise this code branch. The lib verification function has zero direct test coverage.
findings.impact: A future regression that re-introduces the empty-string bypass (e.g., by resetting the function to return 0 under some condition) will pass all 6 tests. For a security-critical gate, test coverage is the observable proof of closure — without it, the CRIT finding cannot be declared closed by inspection alone.
findings.mitigation: Add test_lib_rejects_unconfigured_runtime_binaries: write a wrapper shell script that sources lib/policy_check_invocation.sh and calls scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binaries without the four env vars set; assert exit 1 and 'SCP-E001' in stderr. Alternatively, add a Python integration test that invokes the main script with explicit --allow-env-overrides and SCP_POLICY_CHECK_OPA_BIN='' (empty string) and asserts refusal. Must be added in the same commit as the fix.

findings.claim: mkdir -p + chmod 0700 two-step pattern still present at three sites in scp-policy-check (lines 227-228, 273-274, 367-368). Atomic mkdir -p -m 0700 was specified in R1-SBP-MIN-04 mitigation; not applied in fr1 or fr2.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:227-228: 'mkdir -p "$cache_dir"' then 'chmod 0700 "$cache_dir"'. Lines 273-274: same for conftest cache_dir. Lines 367-368: same for CACHE_ROOT. Unchanged from R2.
findings.impact: Sub-millisecond TOCTOU window between mkdir and chmod on shared-machine or shared-container environments where another process with the same UID can enter or observe the directory.
findings.mitigation: Replace all three occurrences with 'mkdir -p -m 0700 "$dir"'. One-line change per site.

findings.claim: install -m 0755 places binaries world-executable inside 0700 cache directories. R1-SBP-MIN-04 specified install -m 0700; not applied.
findings.impact: Audit inconsistency; directory ACL is effective. If cache_dir permissions are relaxed or bypassed, binaries are world-executable.
findings.mitigation: Change install -m 0755 to install -m 0700 at lines 245 and 308.

findings.claim: Conftest archive_sha256 verification is silently optional via '|| true'. If omitted from a future lockfile bump, archive is extracted without integrity check.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:264: 'expected_archive_sha="$(json_lock_field conftest "$platform_key" archive_sha256 2>/dev/null || true)"'. Line 287: guard skips verification when field is absent. Unchanged from R2.
findings.impact: A 020F Renovate bump PR that omits archive_sha256 silently degrades to binary-only verification, losing MITM protection at the archive extraction stage.
findings.mitigation: Remove '2>/dev/null || true'. If archive_sha256 is absent, emit SCP-E001 and exit 1 unless an explicit 'archive_sha256: none' sentinel is present in the lockfile.

findings.claim: SCP_FIXTURE_PATH is passed directly to git diff in the local script without control-character or traversal validation. CI has a Python + bash guard; the local script does not.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:328: 'git diff --name-only "${SCP_BASE_SHA}..${SCP_HEAD_SHA}" -- "${SCP_FIXTURE_PATH:-.}"' with no preceding validation. policy-check.yml:249-258: Python guard rejects empty and \n \r \x00; policy-check.yml:260: bash guard asserts path exists. Unchanged from R2.
findings.impact: SCP_FIXTURE_PATH=../../etc or a value containing \n silently corrupts the changed-files manifest fed to conftest.
findings.mitigation: Mirror policy-check.yml:249-258 in prepare_changed_files: reject values containing \n \r \x00; if non-default, assert path exists under REPO_ROOT via realpath comparison.

findings.claim: Local script performs no Sigstore gh attestation verify on OPA binary; CI does (policy-check.yml:207). Local-repro and CI paths diverge on supply-chain assurance level.
findings.evidence: policy-check.yml:207: 'gh attestation verify "${BIN_DIR}/opa" --repo open-policy-agent/opa'. scp-policy-check download_opa(): no attestation verify call. Unchanged from R2.
findings.impact: A developer validating findings exclusively via local script operates at lower assurance than CI. A lockfile-committed compromised SHA passes local verification but would be caught by CI Sigstore.
findings.mitigation: In download_opa(), after install, add: 'if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh attestation verify "$binary_path" --repo open-policy-agent/opa || { emit_error "OPA attestation verification failed"; exit 1; }; else emit_warning "gh CLI not found; skipping Sigstore attestation check for OPA"; fi'. Document skip path in ADOPT-001 §12.

findings.claim: Cleanup trap prefix match is fragile on macOS where TMPDIR resolves to /var/folders/... rather than /tmp.
findings.evidence: scp-policy-check:101-103: '[ "${CHANGED_FILES_PATH#${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/scp-policy-check.}" != "${CHANGED_FILES_PATH}" ]'. If TMPDIR unset between mktemp and cleanup, guard uses /tmp which does not match /var/folders path. Unchanged from R2.
findings.impact: Temp file leak on macOS with non-default TMPDIR. File contains repo-relative paths only, no credentials.
findings.mitigation: Replace prefix-match with boolean flag _SCP_CREATED_CHANGED_FILES=0; set to 1 at mktemp; check flag in cleanup trap.

findings.claim: conftest_json temp file in lib/policy_check_invocation.sh has no RETURN trap; python3 heredoc failure leaks the file.
findings.evidence: lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:156: conftest_json=$(mktemp). Cleanup at line 168 (conftest failure) and 226 (success) but not on python3 heredoc non-zero exit (lines 173-224). set -euo pipefail at lib:2 causes immediate function return past line 226. Unchanged from R2.
findings.impact: One leaked temp file per malformed conftest output. No credential content; cosmetic on ephemeral runners.

structured_review.summary: R3 completeness-governance review of slice 020B.2 after fr2. Primary finding: R2-SAF-MAJ-01 (empty-string SHA bypass in scp_policy_check_verify_runtime_binary) is falsely claimed closed — the fr2 dispatcher timed out without applying the fix, and lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-50 still returns 0 unconditionally on empty path or SHA. This is a CRIT finding (R3-COMP-CRIT-01). A companion MAJ (R3-COMP-MAJ-01) records that no test covers this path, making closure unverifiable by test even after the fix is applied in fr3. All 5 MIN and 3 nit findings from R2 are carried forward unchanged — none was addressed in fr2. The 6-AC implementation of 020B.2 is otherwise structurally complete (all ACs pass); the outstanding security gap is entirely in the lib verification gate and its test coverage. §4.3 fixpoint is NOT reached. Requires fr3 to (1) apply the lib:48-49 fix, (2) add a regression test, and (3) re-run the three verify_commands green. Merge to main remains blocked.
structured_review.verdict_rationale: R2-SAF-MAJ-01 (empty-string SHA bypass) is falsely claimed closed by commit 1cbd1e5. The fr2 dispatcher timed out with git_sha_before == git_sha_after == 8d1eaf1; the fix was never applied. lib/policy_check_invocation.sh:48-50 still unconditionally returns 0 when path or expected SHA is empty, leaving the pre-exec verification gate silently bypassable for any external lib adopter. No test covers this path. §4.3 fixpoint cannot be declared with one CRIT and one MAJ outstanding. All MIN/nit findings from R2 are carried forward unchanged.
